Filter a Marker Panel by Data Quality Thresholds

Source: R/filterPanel.R
filterPanel.Rd

Applies a user-defined sequence of data quality filters to a raw marker genotype matrix and its associated genetic map. Filtering is controlled by a single steps named list whose element order determines the execution order. The default steps list applies a statistically principled workflow:

  1. Map consistency (map) — markers absent from map are dropped; always executed first even if omitted from a custom steps list.

  2. Marker missingness (miss.marker) — markers with a missing rate above the threshold are removed first, because a failed genotyping assay inflates apparent line-level missingness.

  3. Line missingness (miss.line) — lines with a missing rate above the threshold are removed on the cleaned marker set.

  4. Line heterozygosity (het.line) — lines with a heterozygosity rate above the threshold are removed. Excess heterozygosity typically indicates a mislabelled or contaminated sample. Skipped by default (NULL).

  5. Marker heterozygosity (het.marker) — markers with a heterozygosity rate above the threshold are removed. High per-marker heterozygosity suggests a paralogous locus or genotyping artefact. Skipped by default (NULL).

  6. Duplicate lines (dup.lines) — lines with identical genotype profiles are dropped (second and subsequent copies), performed after quality filters so that clean copies are retained.

  7. Duplicate markers (dup.markers) — markers with identical genotype profiles are dropped. Skipped by default (FALSE).

  8. MAF (maf) — markers with minor allele frequency below the threshold are removed last, so that allele frequencies are computed on the fully cleaned dataset.

Usage

filterPanel(geno, ...)

# Default S3 method
filterPanel(
  geno,
  map,
  id = "id",
  map.id = "marker",
  map.chr = "chr",
  map.pos = "pos",
  encoding = "012",
  steps = list(map = TRUE, miss.marker = 0.2, miss.line = 0.2, het.line = NULL,
    het.marker = NULL, dup.lines = TRUE, dup.markers = FALSE, maf = 0.05),
  ...
)

# S3 method for class 'checkPanel'
filterPanel(
  geno,
  steps = list(map = TRUE, miss.marker = 0.2, miss.line = 0.2, het.line = NULL,
    het.marker = NULL, dup.lines = TRUE, dup.markers = FALSE, maf = 0.05),
  ...
)

# S3 method for class 'filteredPanel'
filterPanel(
  geno,
  steps = list(map = TRUE, miss.marker = 0.2, miss.line = 0.2, het.line = NULL,
    het.marker = NULL, dup.lines = TRUE, dup.markers = FALSE, maf = 0.05),
  ...
)

Arguments

geno

A numeric matrix (lines x markers) with row names identifying lines, a data.frame with a line identifier column, a "checkPanel" object from checkPanel, or a "filteredPanel" object from a previous filterPanel() call.

...

Currently ignored; reserved for future use.

map

A data.frame containing the genetic map. Not required when geno is a "checkPanel" or "filteredPanel" object (the stored map is used automatically).

id

Character string naming the line identifier column when geno is a data.frame. Default "id".

map.id

Character string naming the marker column in map. Default "marker".

map.chr

Character string naming the chromosome column in map. Default "chr".

map.pos

Character string naming the marker position column in map. Positions are used as supplied — no unit conversion is applied. Default "pos".

encoding

Character string specifying the genotype encoding: "012" (default) or "pm1".

steps

A named list controlling which filters are applied and in what order. Each element name must be one of "map", "miss.marker", "miss.line", "het.line", "het.marker", "dup.lines", "dup.markers", "maf". Numeric steps are skipped when their value is NULL; logical steps (map, dup.lines, dup.markers) are skipped when FALSE. Map consistency is always prepended as step 1 if not already first in the list. The default list reproduces the original fixed workflow.

Value

An object of class "filteredPanel" — a list containing:

$geno

Filtered genotype matrix (current state).

$map

Filtered map data frame (current state).

$encoding, $id, $map.id, $map.chr, $map.pos

Carried through for primePanel.

$history

A list of pass records, one per filterPanel call. Each pass contains $pass (integer), $steps (the steps list used), $removed (named list of removed items per step), $n.before, and $n.after (named integer vectors).

$n.original

Named integer vector (lines, markers) recording the dimensions before the very first filtering pass.

$n.final

Named integer vector (lines, markers) recording the current dimensions after all passes.

Custom step lists

Supply a partial steps list to run only those steps, in the order given. Use modifyList(formals(filterPanel.default)$steps, list(...)) to adjust individual thresholds while keeping all other defaults.

Multi-pass filtering

Passing a "filteredPanel" object as geno runs an additional filtering pass and appends the new pass to $history. print() displays the full audit trail across all passes.
